step1.title: Information Security Graduate
step1.description: Graduated with a B.Eng. in Information Security from the Academy of Cryptography Techniques (KMA), Vietnam — building a strong foundation in secure systems and analytical thinking.

step2.title: Full Stack Developer at VCCorp
step2.description: Started my career at one of Vietnam's largest media technology companies, contributing to Bizfly Email — an enterprise-grade bulk email delivery system.

step3.title: Full Stack Developer at CO-WELL Asia
step3.description: Delivered outsourcing projects for Japanese clients — the Ad-Start advertising platform, TobilaPhone Biz enterprise telephony, and Onsight-php event management system.

step4.title: Full Stack Developer at Coolmate
step4.description: Developed and maintained Coolmate.me, Vietnam's leading men's fashion e-commerce platform — handling high-volume daily transactions.

step5.title: Remote / Freelance Developer
step5.description: Transitioned to remote freelance work for CIT Group (Vietnam) and JAVIS Co., Ltd. (Japan) — shipping Vanda, Heva, Vương Kim Bảo, and Jindo App.

projects.headline: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: 10 shipped production systems built to serve real users and drive real business impact

vanecom.name: Vanda (Vanecom)
vanecom.description: A Vietnamese e-commerce platform with both web and mobile interfaces, powered by the OpenAI API for AI-driven product recommendations and automated customer support.
highlights: Firebase push notifications and live chat

heva.name: Heva
heva.description: Vietnam's leading on-demand home services app — connecting customers with verified professionals for hair styling, beauty treatments, and mother-and-baby care. AdonisJS APIs, real-time chat via Socket.IO, and flexible payments — live on the App Store.
highlights: Multiple payment gateways: MoMo, ZaloPay, VNPay

vuongkimbao.name: Vương Kim Bảo
vuongkimbao.description: A comprehensive feng shui lookup platform that lets users explore their fortune, receive birth-date-based destiny readings, and discover feng shui items matched to their elemental profile. Live on the App Store.
highlights: Product recommendations by Five-Element (Ngũ Hành) profile
Laravel backend powering the mobile app

coolmate.name: Coolmate.me
coolmate.description: Vietnam's leading men's fashion e-commerce platform, handling high-volume daily transactions on a dual-frontend architecture.

jindo.name: Jindo App
jindo.description: A Korean language learning app tailored for Vietnamese users, featuring interactive lessons, quizzes, and progress tracking.

adstart.name: Ad-Start
adstart.description: A centralized advertising management platform for Facebook and Google campaigns — automated ad creation, real-time performance dashboards, audience management, and budget control.
highlights: Facebook Marketing & Google Ads API integration

onsight.name: Onsight-php
onsight.description: An event management platform for creating, scheduling, and tracking events, with real-time updates and calendar integrations.
highlights: Interactive calendar views built in ReactJS
Real-time event updates and push notifications

tobilaphone.name: TobilaPhone Biz
tobilaphone.description: An enterprise telephony solution for filtering, blocking, and managing unwanted or spam calls, with a centralized admin dashboard.
highlights: Spam-call filtering engine and blacklist management

bizfly.name: Bizfly Email
bizfly.description: An enterprise bulk email delivery system supporting scenario-based triggers, dynamic content personalization, and proactive spam-risk alerting.
highlights: MongoDB optimized for high-volume email logs

remoteoffer.name: Remote-Offer
remoteoffer.description: A recruitment platform enabling companies to post job listings, manage candidates, and publish company blogs, with Stripe integration for paid postings and subscriptions.
highlights: Stripe integration for paid postings and subscriptions
Streamlined job search and application workflows
